assessment: This is an important and methodologically compelling paper that provides novel views on the functional plasticity of cortical networks following noise trauma. The combination of cortical recordings, optogenetics, and behavior provides valuable mechanistic insights into the processes that may underlie auditory hypersensitivity after cochlear damage. The extensive and well-illustrated manuscript provides an excellent example of a study in which modern neurophysiology techniques advance comprehension of pathologies related to maladaptive changes in the brain.
